description: This file defines mock classes for testing, specifically DobbyProxyMock and IpcServiceMock, which mock interfaces for Dobby proxy operations and IPC service functionalities respectively.

classes.name: DobbyProxyMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IDobbyProxy interface, providing mock implementations for container management functions.

classes.name: IpcServiceMock
classes.description: Mock class for AI_IPC::IIpcService, providing mock implementations for IPC service management functions.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Mocks the shutdown method of IDobbyProxy.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Mocks the ping method of IDobbyProxy.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Mocks check if the container or proxy is alive.

methods.name: setLogMethod
methods.description: Mocks setting the log method configuration.

methods.name: startContainerFromSpec
methods.description: Mocks starting a container from a specification.

methods.name: startContainerFromBundle
methods.description: Mocks starting a container from a bundle.

methods.name: execInContainer
methods.description: Mocks executing a command inside a container.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Mocks registering a state change listener.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Mocks unregistering a state change listener.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Mocks checking validity of IPC service.

methods.name: isServiceAvailable
methods.description: Mocks checking if a specific IPC service is available.
